description: This Java source file defines an abstract class TimeMeasuringAuthenticationProvider that wraps authentication logic with timing and logging functionality. It is part of a security/authentication package within a larger project, specifically designed to measure execution time and handle errors during authentication requests.

classes.name: TimeMeasuringAuthenticationProvider
classes.description: An abstract class that adds timing and error handling to authentication providers, measuring how long authentication takes and logging errors.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs authentication with timing and error handling, returning a CompletableFuture of AuthenticationResult.

methods.name: getRootCause
methods.description: Extracts the root cause from a Throwable, unwrapping CompletionException if necessary.

methods.name: isInternalError
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status code indicates an internal error.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Abstract method to return the AuthorizationContextType, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: tryToAuthenticate
methods.description: Abstract method for performing the actual authentication logic, returning a CompletableFuture.

methods.name: toFailedAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Abstract method to create a failed AuthenticationResult based on an exception.

methods.name: toDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts a Throwable into a DittoRuntimeException, unwrapping and wrapping as needed.

methods.name: unwrapDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Recursively unwraps a Throwable to find a DittoRuntimeException or return null.

methods.name: failOnTimeout
methods.description: Wraps an authentication future to handle timeouts and failures.

methods.name: buildInternalErrorException
methods.description: Creates a GatewayAuthenticationProviderUnavailableException wrapping a cause and headers.
